current_leader.name: Processor native-currency settlement optimizer
current_leader.state_transition: foreign-currency processor balance appears -> matching settlement-account availability and processor fee schedule are known -> compare native payout cost with processor conversion and forecast same-currency obligations -> recommend keep-native or convert -> verify avoided FX/payout fees
current_leader.why_survived: Stripe still documents a deterministic no-conversion state when the payout currency has an eligible matching bank account; without one Stripe converts the payout balance to the account default currency. Multi-currency settlement can itself carry roughly 1% payout fees in supported markets while instant balance conversion starts around 0.5%, so the decision has an objectively measurable dollar consequence. No exact lightweight read-only product was found that combines PSP balances, PSP fee schedules and external same-currency obligations to continuously recommend native settlement versus conversion without executing FX or owning the rail. However, this run downgraded recurring leakage from PASS to UNCERTAIN because best-practice static multi-currency setup may capture most of the value.
current_leader.closest_threat: Broad multi-currency treasury/payment platforms increasingly hold, convert and route balances natively; Pockyt explicitly markets holding multiple currencies and paying suppliers in native currency, while Stripe itself provides the settlement primitives. The wedge survives only if external obligations make the optimal keep-native/convert decision change often enough after competent static configuration.
current_leader.smallest_intervention: Read-only v1: ingest authorized PSP balances by currency, configured settlement accounts, processor conversion/native-payout fee tables and upcoming AP/card obligations by currency; output KEEP NATIVE or CONVERT with expected deterministic fee difference. Do not initiate payouts, conversions or hold funds.
current_leader.monetization: Small per-value-event fee, per-currency-month fee, or capped share of verified PSP FX/payout fees avoided, benchmarked against competent static multi-currency configuration.
current_leader.biggest_unresolved_risk: A one-time setup of matching USD/EUR/GBP accounts may capture most savings. If dynamic obligation-aware decisions add little beyond that baseline, recurring monetization fails even though the underlying FX leakage is real.
current_leader.next_research_test: Quantify incremental dynamic savings after best-practice static multi-currency setup using merchant currency-mix and foreign-obligation patterns. Test whether the optimal keep-native/convert choice changes often enough month to month. If dynamic delta is small, reject this candidate and promote merchant settlement acceleration or a new event-level candidate.

recent_cross_family_findings: Processor-native currency settlement remains technically clean, but recurring leakage must now be measured only after competent static multi-currency setup; this demoted leakage magnitude from 4 to 3 and Gate 2 from PASS to UNCERTAIN.

Stripe's current primitives make the financial delta explicit: eligible matching payout-currency accounts avoid conversion, while multi-currency settlement and balance conversion can carry percentage fees.
Hotel OTA virtual-card recovery is now an explicit rejection: multiple exact products detect undercharged, uncharged and expiring VCCs and recover them, often on performance pricing.
Insurance broker commission underpayment recovery is now an explicit rejection: multiple exact products compare carrier statements against expected commissions and flag missing/underpaid amounts.
Post-booking hotel price-drop rebooking is occupied by dedicated products and first-party travel systems that automatically monitor and rebook refundable reservations.
SaaS/vendor contract-to-invoice overcharge recovery is occupied by current contingency-fee and continuous-audit products.
New search rule: configuration optimizers get credit only for incremental recurring value beyond best-practice static setup; one-time cleanup value does not satisfy recurring leakage.
known_rejected_or_demoted_summary: Full historical rejection list is preserved in prior anchor blobs and immutable run files. Do not revive prior rejected families without materially new mechanism/evidence.
